_about: The Foundry toolbox the hosted agent consumes, plus its project connections. Tool fields (type, server_label, server_url, require_approval, allowed_tools, project_connection_id) and authType values (custom-keys, oauth2, ...) are Microsoft's. 'mcp_servers' (what each server offers) and 'credential_owner' are lab shorthand.
